replaces.distinction: The previous manifest directly installed an official HTTPS binary tarball, not the npm HTTP-downloader implementation. Its SC4 runtime was nevertheless obsolete. This adapter installs a supported SC5 release over HTTPS with pinned official SHA256, and preserves the project's legacy process interface.

updatePolicy: Choose a current official release; independently retrieve all platform SHA256 values from official documentation; update binary URLs and compatibility mappings; rerun archive verification/readiness/PID/termination tests and the actual supported-platform --version command.
